title: Beal Conjecture — v8.9.0 Real 80-Check Audit
description: Version 8.9.0 records an honest executable Phase A finite audit for the level-26 route in Lean 4. The complete grid of eight S-unit representatives against ten quartics gives 80 entries. All 80 entries pass the available local checks at p = 2 and p = 13, so all eight representatives remain. This is not a singleton 2-Selmer computation and not an unconditional proof of the Beal Conjecture. SecondDescentHypothesis_26, Jacobian transport, formal immersion, modularity, and level lowering remain explicit conditional boundaries.
